name: EMI calculator
author: friday-core
description: Computes a reducing-balance loan EMI with total interest, total payable and the first months of the schedule, and estimates a SIP (monthly compounding, instalment at the start or end of the month) or a lumpsum at a yearly return you give. An estimate from your numbers: a lender's schedule can differ by a few rupees, and an investment return is never guaranteed.
